_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md)

pit_profile.why: Accenture: #1-scale IT-services and consulting franchise that took share through the cloud cycle; discretionary consulting demand is cyclical, the franchise is not

theme_watch.reason: Live since 2022-11-30 and already repricing obvious losers (Chegg, 2023-05-02), but the sell-side read for ACN was share gain (J.P.Morgan, 2023-02-10) and the stock trades at 26.7x FY23E — a premium, not an AI discount. Re-file under DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (GENAI) only when the multiple starts discounting the legacy-services deflation J.P.Morgan describes, or it shows up in managed-services growth.

classification.quality_note: Accenture: #1-scale IT-services and consulting franchise that took share through the cloud cycle; discretionary consulting demand is cyclical, the franchise is not. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 1.71x; +48% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -1.35; conservative 2yr -8%.

BEAR.desc: Flat EPS (worst year FY12-FY22, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +5.8%/yr (latest guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +10.8%/yr (FY12-FY22 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +16.5%/yr (best 2-yr run FY12-FY22); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: ACN (retrospective, 2023-06-30) ◐ WATCHLIST — Ratio B 1.71x (34.5% downside to Bear $202 / +20.2% upside to Bull $371) | Adj composite 1.98 vs market 3.33: gap -1.35 [OVERVALUED] | +48% above the EPP floor $208 (18x FY23E $11.57) | Conservative 2-yr case: -8.1% total (-4.1%/yr) | At 26.7x FY23E the 15% hurdle price $408 sits above the BULL case; consulting -1% LC in Q3, Q4 guided +2-6% LC; GenAI is a live theme, read by the sell side as share gain for consultancies, not a threat.
